title: More Tools so cool
description: Un mod ajoutant plusieurs nouveaux outils extrêmement pratique ! A mod adding several new, extremely practical tools !
body:
Finally get some cool tools in Minecraft!
Craft steel using iron and coal, and make even stronger tools!

This mod adds various tools:
- A steel pickaxe
- A steel axe
- A steel hoe
- A steel shovel
- A steel sword
- A hammer that works on all types of materials
- A pitchfork in all material types

The hammer allows you to mine in a 3x3 area, and the pitchfork works in a 3x3 area.
The steel hoe plants the seeds held in the off-hand.
 

**Recipes are in images section.**
